Let \(m=2q^2\), the number of transpositions in \(\pi\).

For a lift \(\sigma\) of \(\pi\), write
\[
\sigma(\rho_j)=\zeta^{s_j}\rho_j,\qquad
\sigma(\alpha_i^{(j)})=\zeta^{a_i^{(j)}}\alpha_{\pi(i)}^{(j)} .
\]
The Kummer relations give
\[
\sum_i a_i^{(j)}=0\quad(j<r),\qquad
\sum_i a_i^{(r)}=\sum_{j=1}^r s_j.
\]
Conjugating by \(\operatorname{Gal}(L/M)\) changes \(a_i^{(j)}\) by coboundaries
\[
a_i^{(j)}\mapsto a_i^{(j)}+b_{\pi(i)}^{(j)}-b_i^{(j)},
\]
so the invariant data are the pair-sums
\[
v_t=\bigl(a_i^{(1)}+a_{\pi(i)}^{(1)},\dots,a_i^{(r)}+a_{\pi(i)}^{(r)}\bigr)\in\mathbb F_\ell^r
\]
for the \(m=2q^2\) transposition pairs. The centralizer of \(\pi\) only permutes these pairs, hence an orbit is a multiset \(\{v_t\}_{t=1}^m\) with
\[
\sum_t v_t=\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^r s_j\Bigr)e_r.
\]

For \(k\in\mathbb F_\ell^r\), a \(2\)-cycle on \(\Omega_k\) occurs from an ordered pair of transposition-pairs \((x,y)\) exactly when
\[
y-x=2(k_1s_1,\dots,k_rs_r),
\]
with the special same-pair contribution at \(k=0\). Thus the required three-level cycle-count condition is exactly a three-level autocorrelation condition for the multiset of \(v_t\).

The stated numerical differences force the autocorrelation Fourier magnitudes to be
\[
q,\qquad q+2Q,\qquad q+4Q
\]
on the three dual layers. Since
\[
q,\ q+2Q,\ q+4Q\equiv q\equiv 2^{-1}\pmod \ell
\]
and \(2\) generates \(\mathbb F_\ell^\times\), these primes are inert in \(\mathbb Q(\zeta)\). Hence the multiplier argument forces the multiset to be uniquely determined by the flag and \(s\). Its distinguished point is
\[
a=2\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^r s_j\Bigr)e_r,
\]
which is exactly compatible with
\[
\sum_t v_t=\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^r s_j\Bigr)e_r
\]
because \(q\equiv 2^{-1}\pmod \ell\).

So the count is just:

- choose \(s=(s_1,\dots,s_r)\in(\mathbb F_\ell^\times)^r\) with \(S=\sum s_j\neq0\);
- choose a flag \(W\subset U\subset\mathbb F_\ell^r\) with \(\operatorname{codim}U=1\), \(\operatorname{codim}W=2\), and \(Se_r\in U\setminus W\).

The number of such \(s\) is
\[
(l-1)^r-\frac{(l-1)^r+(l-1)(-1)^r}{l}
=
\frac{(l-1)\bigl((l-1)^r-(-1)^r\bigr)}{l}.
\]
For each nonzero \(S\), the number of flags with \(Se_r\in U\setminus W\) is
\[
\frac{\ell^{r-1}-1}{\ell-1}\cdot \ell^{r-2}.
\]
Multiplying gives
\[
\boxed{\ell^{r-3}\bigl(\ell^{r-1}-1\bigr)\bigl((\ell-1)^r-(-1)^r\bigr)}.
\]
